brief:
Ramallah hosted a dialogue session examining the results of the 2025 Programme for International Student Assessment and their implications for Palestinian education, the Maan news agency reported. The session brought together stakeholders to discuss how the findings should shape future educational policy and practice in Palestinian territories.

PISA assessments measure student performance in reading, mathematics, and science across participating nations, providing comparative data on education system effectiveness. The dialogue focused on translating the assessment outcomes into actionable insights for improving Palestinian schools.
title: Palestine holds dialogue on PISA 2025 results and education future
